place.title: Place {ref} (vibration sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: VCC into {hole.vcc}, GND into {hole.gnd}, DO into {hole.do}. The small metal can (the vibration switch) is at the top.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture.

why: {ref} has a small spring switch in a metal can that opens and closes while it shakes; its comparator turns that into a clean on/off signal on DO, and its second LED blinks.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its outputs are never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s DO output: it changes for a moment on each shake or knock. The module drives this line itself.
